Harishchandra Budhaji Warghade vs The State Of Maharashtra
on 7 August, 2025

2025: Bhc-As:33947
 52-Aba-2475-2023
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay

 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2475 Of 2023
 Harishchandra Budhaji Warghade ...Applica
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra ...Respond

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
* * *
 Mr. Nilesh Navale for the Applicant.
 Sneha Mr. R.M. Pethe, App for Respondent/State.

Nitin
 Chavan Hc Ganesh Pawar attached to Kinhavali Police Station present.

** *
 Digitally signed
 by Sneha
 Nitin Chavan
 Date: 2025.08.08

Coram : M.M. Sathaye, J.
10:38:14 +0530 Date : 7th August, 2025 P.C. :
1.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 55 of 2023 registered with Kinhavali Police Station, Thane for offence punishable under Section 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of IPC.

Applicant is accused No.2.
2.

The allegation in the FIR is that on realizing that name of a third person is mutated in the record of rights of the first informant's land, upon inquiry it transpired that the present Applicant and co- accused had introduced a person (Accused No.3) as the real owner in the place of the complainant and had got sale deed executed.
3.

Learned Counsel for the Applicant submitted that role attributed by the Applicant is only to introduce the alleged imposter as real owner and he has not acted as imposter or has received any benefit/money from the transaction.

sentences.text: 4. Admittedly, from 04.09.2023, the Applicant has been protected under order of this Court.
5. Learned APP on instructions from officer of the concerned Police Station (who is present in the Court) submitted that investigation is complete and charge-sheet is already filed.
He further submitted that Case No. RCC/395/2023 is already filed in the Court of J.M.F.C. Shahapur.
It is contended that during investigation it has transpired that the Applicant had accompanied one of the co-accused to Aadhar Seva Kendra, where the alleged forgery took place.

6. Considering the nature of allegations and the fact that the Applicant is already protected for last about 2 years and further considering the fact that the charge-sheet is already filed, a case for grant of this application is made out.
Hence, the following order.
(i) The anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 04.09.2023.
(ii) The Applicant is directed to attend the Trial Court regularly unless exempted by the concerned Trial Court.
7. Anticipatory bail application is disposed of in above terms.
8. Observations made in this order are limited to deciding anticipatory bail application and the Trial Court will decide the case on its own merits, without being affected by this order.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
